extracted.intended_audience: public information officers (PIOs) at research institutions, journal publishers, medical centers, government agencies, corporations, and working journalists who use EurekAlert!
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and eligibility criteria for submitting science news releases and hosting newsrooms on the EurekAlert! distribution platform, and rules for reporter access (including embargoed content).

rubrics_metrics.name: News release eligibility guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases must meet EurekAlert!'s longstanding eligibility guidelines in order to be accepted and hosted on the website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page repeatedly states that releases must meet EurekAlert!'s eligibility guidelines and links to www.eurekalert.org/releaseguidelines for the full rules. Note that meeting eligibility is required for acceptance; see the linked guidelines for full criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may contribute content
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! only accepts content contributions from public information officers (PIOs) at eligible organizations that conduct, publish, or fund scientific research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIOs wishing to submit must meet EurekAlert!'s eligibility criteria, complete the online application form, and pay a submission fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission fees and acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutions must pay a fee to submit news releases to EurekAlert!.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Payment of submission fees does not guarantee acceptance of news releases. The page emphasizes that fees are required for submission but acceptance remains contingent on meeting eligibility/guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of information hosted / acceptable content
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! hosts news releases that may describe research findings recently published in peer-reviewed journals, timely information related to the business, innovation, and societal aspects of science, and details of grants, awards and honors, books, and scientific meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EurekAlert! also hosts online newsrooms or news portals (microsites) for journal publishers, government agencies, scientific meetings and other organizations; these microsites aggregate news releases published by or relevant to those organizations or meetings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargoed content and reporter access
rubrics_metrics.description: Working reporters who meet EurekAlert!'s eligibility criteria may apply for free access to the reporter-only section, which hosts embargoed news releases and press materials provided by academic journals and research institutions for the exclusive use of working journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporters with access can receive services like customizable daily e-mail alerts of embargoed news releases. All embargoed news releases are made freely available to the public at the designated embargo-release time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processing timeframe / office hours
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert!'s office hours are 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday (excluding holidays).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions or inquiries received during office hours will be processed the same day. Submissions received outside office hours will be processed on the next business day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public availability of hosted releases
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases hosted on EurekAlert! are freely available to members of the public at www.eurekalert.org; no registration necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While the public can view hosted releases, embargoed content is available earlier only to authorized reporters until embargo-release time when it becomes public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to certain services for qualifying PIOs
rubrics_metrics.description: Working public information officers (PIOs) who meet EurekAlert!'s eligibility criteria may apply for free access to certain services on EurekAlert! and purchase access to submit news releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This distinguishes general public availability from gated services (submission tools, etc.) available to eligible PIOs upon application and (where applicable) payment.
